title: Cinnamon Bun's Big Speech
synopsis: Cinnamon Bun has to give a speech to the entire Fire Kingdom and prepares by rewriting it four hundred times.
plot:
Flame Princess asks Cinnamon Bun, her most loyal knight, to give the address at the Fire Kingdom's Ember Festival. He is honored and immediately terrified. He has never given a speech. He writes one, hates it, writes another, and by the third day has a stack of drafts taller than his fire wolf.

Finn visits and offers to help. They try flash cards, a teleprompter Flambo holds in his mouth, and practicing in front of the Fire Wolf, who falls asleep. Every draft is either too long, too short, or, in one case, entirely about soup. Cinnamon Bun begins to believe that Flame Princess made a mistake choosing him.

At the festival, Cinnamon Bun walks to the podium, opens his mouth, and drops all four hundred pages into the lava. He stands there. Then he says that he is not smart, but he is here, and he will always be here, and that's what a knight is. He sits down. The Fire Kingdom is silent for a full second, then roars. Flame Princess tells him it was the best speech she has ever heard. He asks if he can have some soup now.
transcriptText:
Flame Princess: Cinnamon Bun. I want you to give the Ember Festival address.
Cinnamon Bun: Me? Really? Yes! Yes yes yes! [pause] What's an address?
Flame Princess: A speech.
Cinnamon Bun: Oh. Oh no.
[Three days later. Cinnamon Bun surrounded by paper.]
Finn: CB, how many drafts is this?
Cinnamon Bun: Four hundred and eleven. This one's about soup.
Finn: Why is it about soup?
Cinnamon Bun: I got hungry in the middle and forgot to stop.
Flambo: [holding a teleprompter in his mouth] Mmmf mmf mmf.
Cinnamon Bun: [reading] 'Citizens of the Fire Kingdom—' Flambo, you're drooling on it.
Flambo: Mmmf.
Finn: Try it on the wolf.
Cinnamon Bun: Citizens of the Fire Kingdom, today we gather—
[The Fire Wolf is asleep.]
Cinnamon Bun: She picked wrong, Finn. She should've picked someone smart.
Finn: She didn't pick you 'cause you're smart, CB.
Cinnamon Bun: That's what I'm saying!
Finn: No, I mean— never mind. You'll figure it out.
[The Ember Festival. The whole kingdom watches. Cinnamon Bun approaches the podium with his stack.]
Cinnamon Bun: Citizens of the— [the stack slips and falls into the lava] ...
Flame King: [from the lantern] Ha! Typical!
[Cinnamon Bun stands in silence.]
Cinnamon Bun: I'm not smart. I know that. But I'm here. And I'll always be here. That's what a knight is. Okay. That's it.
[He sits down. One second of silence. Then the kingdom ROARS.]
Flame Princess: [quietly] That's the best speech I've ever heard.
Cinnamon Bun: Can I have soup now?
Flame Princess: You can have all the soup.
